b0.label: B0 single call
b0.description: One model call receives all sources. No tools, state, approval, or verification.

b1.label: B1 fixed pipeline
b1.description: Hard-coded plan, same tools, trace, and approval gate. No replanning, no grounding revision, lessons saved but unused.

p-m.label: P-M without memory
p-m.description: Provider-generated validated plan, replanning, and grounding revision. No lessons.

p.label: P proposed
p.description: P-M plus lessons retrieved from development-split runs.
